Contributions to Workshop "3D-Stadtmodelle, Bonn"

On November 8-9, 2011, the third workshop on 3D City Models was held in Bonn; our working group could contribute two presentations to this event. Prof. Jürgen discussed challenges and potentials regarding the “Analysis and Visualization of massive, semantically classified 3D point clouds” and Benjamin Hagedorn presented the setting and first results of the “OGC 3D Portrayal Interoperability Experiment”.

All presentations are available at the workshop homepage.
